data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: agent-skills
edge_embedded.summary: Agent Skills 是一个为 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code 和 Cursor）精心策划的生产级工程技能集合。它解决了代理在真实软件工程任务中缺乏领域专业知识的问题。该项目提供可复用的技能定义，教会代理如何处理复杂工作流，例如调试、重构或部署。技术上，它通过结构化提示和工具配置来编码专家知识。你可以将这些技能集成到自己的代理设置中，提升其在实践编码挑战中的能力，使 AI 助手在专业开发中更可靠。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Agent Skills is a curated collection of production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor. It solves the problem of agents lacking domain-specific expertise in real-world software engineering tasks. The project provides reusable skill definitions that teach agents how to handle complex workflows, such as debugging, refactoring, or deploying. Technically, it uses structured prompts and tool configurations to encode expert knowledge. You can integrate these skills into your own agent setup to boost its competence on practical coding challenges, making AI assistants more reliable for professional development.

ui_devex.name: financial-services
ui_devex.summary: Anthropic推出的开源工具集Financial-services，旨在利用Claude模型构建金融AI应用。它通过可复用代码模板和最佳实践，降低大语言模型集成到受监管工作流的门槛，解决合规性、可解释性和数据安全等要求。核心优势包括内置文档分析、风险评估和客户支持示例，强调输出可控性与审计追踪。开发者可快速原型化合规智能客服、自动化报告生成或可解释欺诈检测系统，提升业务效率。
ui_devex.summary_en: Financial-services is a collection of open-source tools and templates from Anthropic for building AI-powered financial applications. It leverages Claude's capabilities for tasks like document analysis, risk assessment, and customer support. The project provides reusable code patterns and best practices for integrating large language models into regulated workflows. Developers can use these resources to prototype compliance-aware chatbots, automate report generation, or enhance fraud detection systems with explainable AI.

security_safety.name: financial-services
security_safety.summary: Anthropic推出的开源工具集Financial-services，旨在利用Claude模型构建金融AI应用。它通过可复用代码模板和最佳实践，降低大语言模型集成到受监管工作流的门槛，解决合规性、可解释性和数据安全等要求。核心优势包括内置文档分析、风险评估和客户支持示例，强调输出可控性与审计追踪。开发者可快速原型化合规智能客服、自动化报告生成或可解释欺诈检测系统，提升业务效率。
security_safety.summary_en: Financial-services is a collection of open-source tools and templates from Anthropic for building AI-powered financial applications. It leverages Claude's capabilities for tasks like document analysis, risk assessment, and customer support. The project provides reusable code patterns and best practices for integrating large language models into regulated workflows. Developers can use these resources to prototype compliance-aware chatbots, automate report generation, or enhance fraud detection systems with explainable AI.
